entries.3c9e1c6cda210460: The company sets out "Chouetsu" as its management philosophy and aims, by connecting people and technology, to provide products and services that give excitement and joy exceeding satisfaction. As a medium- to long-term strategy, in the game business, in addition to planning and development, it will expand its domain into fields that support a structure in which creators can concentrate on development and distribute in Japan and overseas; in the mobile business, it will increase store profitability by appealing to a sense of security through in-store support and providing in-store experiences, and pursue opportunities to expand new store operation businesses leveraging the know-how and human resources cultivated in store operations. In its medium-term management plan (from the fiscal year ended June 2025 to the fiscal year ending June 2027), it sets strengthening business profitability and improving the return on invested capital as medium- to long-term management issues.
